index.title: Route 66 Guides: Planning, Stops and Road Stories · Route 66 Logbook
index.description: Route 66 guides from a traveller who drove it end to end: how many days you need, how to plan an itinerary, the famous stops and hidden gems, ghost towns, neon, history and more.
index.ogDescription: Fifteen long reads on planning and driving the Mother Road, from how many days you need to the hidden gems most travellers miss.
index.lede: Fifteen long reads from the Mother Road: how to plan it, where to stop, and what makes it more than a highway. Written after driving it end to end in its centennial year.
